faq.q: Can I plan my own file from these examples?
faq.a: Yes. Each example shows a source photo and a finished direction. Upload your product photo and ask for that same kind of scene.

faq.q: Why is there no price on the examples?
faq.a: Prices, headlines, and captions are added by you after download. The example stops at the product picture or clip.

faq.q: What should I check on a still example?
faq.a: Check that the product's shape and color still match your photo, and that the scene is one you would actually post. Then try that same kind of still with your own item.

faq.q: How do I choose a still versus a clip?
faq.a: Choose a still when the listing gallery needs a scene. Choose a clip when the selling point is motion, such as a pour, a spray, or a try-on.

faq.q: Can I use a file I make from an example in a paid ad?
faq.a: Yes. Files you generate can be used commercially and have no watermark. The example images on this page are demonstrations, not assets to download and repost.

faq.q: Will my result match the example exactly?
faq.a: No. Your file is built from your photo, in the direction you picked. Check the product before you post it. A failed job returns its credits.

faq.q: Which frame should I try first?
faq.a: Try 1:1 for a listing gallery and 9:16 for a full-screen clip. Other frames are 16:9, 4:3, and 3:4. Clip lengths are 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds.
